evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/nfc/NFCAccessController.ts:383 — Apple Wallet pass built with passTypeIdentifier: 'pass.bit.two.three.ppt.access'. The first three reverse-DNS labels are scrambled: the repo's documented package namespace (CLAUDE.md) is 'three.two.bit.ppt' and iOS bundle ids are 'three.two.bit.ppt.reality'/'.management', so the convention-correct value is 'pass.three.two.bit.ppt.access', not 'pass.bit.two.three...'.

Apple requires passTypeIdentifier to exactly match a Pass Type ID registered in the Developer Portal + provisioning profile; a scrambled reverse-DNS id will not match, so NativeWallet.addPass(...) at NFCAccessController.ts:391 fails and addToWallet() returns a rejected/false result on iOS (Add-to-Wallet for building access is broken).

Static-analysis confidence medium: the exact id registered in the Apple portal is not visible in-repo, but the value contradicts the repo's own stated namespace convention, which is the strongest available signal of a typo.
